title: Sprint-sliced launch wave allocator and cutover safety-net for runtime/console/API
creator: Asha Menon
description: Establish a sprint-sliced 'wave allocator' and associated cutover safety-net to coordinate concurrent launches across Runtime, Console, and API teams. Goal: enable multiple small launch waves per release with automated capacity gating, clear rollback triggers, and integrated communication paths to reduce blast radius while preserving velocity.
background: Recent releases with large monolithic cutovers caused prolonged rollback windows and unclear ownership. Engineering and console teams prefer smaller, more frequent waves but lack agreed gating rules and a shared allocator to prevent capacity collisions.
acceptance_criteria: Wave allocator prototype deployed to staging and wired to launch-calendar service
Capacity gate rules defined and implemented (latency, error-rate, model-variant capacity)
Runbook with rollback triggers and owner list documented and reviewed
Automated alerts wired to on-call channels for gate breaches
Two pilot launches completed (runtime micro-change and console UI flag) with zero customer-facing incidents
milestones: Design wave allocator policy and draft gating rules - due 2025-02-28
Prototype allocator UI and API - due 2025-03-18
Integrate capacity signals and enforce gates in staging - due 2025-03-31
Run two pilot waves across runtime/console - due 2025-04-10
risks: Insufficient telemetry to enforce gates -> fallback to manual gating
Model fallback variants not tested across all regions
High concurrency launches could still saturate shared infra if allocator bugs exist
Rollbacks across multiple services require scripted choreography to avoid partial state
comments: 2025-02-12 | Asha Menon: Drafted proposal after sync with runtime and console leads. Decided on sprint-slicing rather than feature-flag cohorts.
2025-02-18 | Priya Shah: Shared performance constraints - need kernel-level rollout for model variants; ENG-47290 created.
2025-02-21 | Marco Ruiz: Console team will run first pilot for a UI-only toggle; will require telemetry patch ENG-48901.
2025-02-26 | Daniel Kim: SRE concern - alerting thresholds need calibration; proposed testing window on 2025-03-04.
notes: This ticket coordinates cross-team experimentation to inform a broader launch cadence policy. Aim to keep pilots lightweight with explicit stop/go decision points after each pilot.
next_steps: Finalize gating rules with SRE and Runtime by 2025-02-28
Allocate sandbox infra for prototype allocator by 2025-03-04
Schedule pilot waves and pre-flight checklist review by 2025-03-10
